# compressed air storage

Operators report that availability improved after a firmware update to the inverters. The control system dispatches the plant in five-minute intervals against the wholesale price. Commissioning tests ran for several weeks before the plant joined the balancing market. Degradation is tracked with a monthly capacity test at a fixed state of charge.

Maintenance crews inspect the containment and the power electronics on a quarterly schedule. Noise from the cooling fans stays below the limits agreed with the neighbouring village. The plant can black-start a nearby gas turbine, which the grid operator tests twice a year. Weather data from a nearby station is used to forecast charging opportunities a day ahead.

Insurance terms were negotiated after a review of fire suppression and thermal monitoring. A community fund receives a small share of the revenue from frequency regulation services. Data from the site feeds a public dashboard that shows charging and discharging in real time. A second phase is under discussion, depending on the outcome of the next capacity auction.
